name: @pipeworx/mcp-core-research

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search open-access research papers by keyword (e.g., "machine learning healthcare"). Returns titles, authors, abstracts, DOIs, and download links. Useful for literature reviews and finding academic sources.

query.description: Search query (e.g., "climate change mitigation", "CRISPR gene editing")

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Get full metadata for a research paper by its CORE ID. Returns title, authors, abstract, full text link, DOI, publisher, year, and citation count.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-core-research forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the core-research pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
